record.original_question: Is the category Co-Sob reflective in Top0?

evidence.quote: Question 9.8. Is Co-Sob reflective in Top0?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Recall that a topological space $X$ is called sober if every nonempty irreducible closed subset of $X$ is the closure of a unique point. Dually, a $T_0$ topological space $X$ is called co-sober if every irreducible (i.e., not expressible as a finite union of proper compact saturated subsets) compact saturated subset of $X$ is the saturation $\uparrow x = \bigcap\{U : U \text{ open}, x \in U\}$ of a unique point $x \in X$, where the saturation is taken with respect to the specialization order.

Let $\mathbf{Top}_0$ denote the category whose objects are $T_0$ topological spaces and whose morphisms are continuous maps, and let $\mathbf{Co\text{-}Sob}$ denote its full subcategory consisting of co-sober spaces.

Question: Is $\mathbf{Co\text{-}Sob}$ a reflective subcategory of $\mathbf{Top}_0$? That is, does the inclusion functor $\mathbf{Co\text{-}Sob} \hookrightarrow \mathbf{Top}_0$ admit a left adjoint?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches for the reflectivity of the category of co-sober spaces in $\mathbf{Top}_0$ did not return a definitive resolution. Related work establishes that sober Scott spaces are not always co-sober and that sobriety and co-sobriety are independent properties, but no source found explicitly affirms or refutes that $\mathbf{Co\text{-}Sob}$ is reflective in $\mathbf{Top}_0$. Status appears unresolved based on accessible literature.

status_evidence.title: Sober Scott Spaces are not always co-sober
status_evidence.snippet: Shows sobriety does not imply co-sobriety; introduces and studies co-sober spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Co-sober spaces are an active object of study; the relationship to sober spaces is nontrivial.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of open problems on sober and related categories of T0 spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Reflectivity questions for related subcategories of Top0 remain a topic of open investigation.
